Messages.Author: Harry Smith
Messages.Body:
This is mainly a question about Konstantin, Baro of the Caravan, but it
also kind of applies to cards like Canine Horde, etc. Any, Konstantin
says '...may steal equipment from another minion...' Now, since it
doesn't say 'a piece of equipment', does that mean you may steal any/all
equipment that minion has, since the word 'equipment' could be either
singular or plural? Likewise, could you destroy several pieces of
equipment with Canine Horde, since it says 'destroy equipment with first
strike?'

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Harry Smith <hsm...@garfield.msms.doe.k12.ms.us> wrote:
>This is mainly a question about Konstantin, Baro of the Caravan, but it
>also kind of applies to cards like Canine Horde, etc. Any, Konstantin
>says '...may steal equipment from another minion...' Now, since it
>doesn't say 'a piece of equipment', does that mean you may steal any/all
>equipment that minion has, since the word 'equipment' could be either
>singular or plural? Likewise, could you destroy several pieces of
>equipment with Canine Horde, since it says 'destroy equipment with first
>strike?'

No. "Steal equipment" and "destroy equipment" effects only allow you to
choose one piece of equipment (rulebook).
